plan.major: Agricultural Economics — Finance and Real Estate Option
plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Agricultural Economics — Finance and Real Estate Option (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] Students under ROTC contract, see Requirement 7 of the Requirements for a Baccalaureate Degree.
[grid1 fn3] Any course offered by the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences, except 285s, 484s, 485s and agricultural economics courses.
[grid1 fn4] The Graduation requirements include a requirement for 3 hours of international and cultural diversity courses and 3 hours of cultural discourse courses. A course satisfying a Core category, a college/department requirement or a free elective can be used to satisfy this requirement. See academic advisor.
[grid1 fn5] All undergraduate students must take at least two (2) specific courses in their major designated as writing intensive (W). This course is an approved W course.
[grid1 fn6] Six hours to be selected in one or more departments outside of the Department of Agricultural Economics. A minimum of 3 of these hours must be at the 300-400 level. To be selected in consultation with an advisor.
[grid1 fn7] Select from AGEC 315 , AGEC 316 , AGEC 324 , AGEC 325 , AGEC 326 , AGEC 344 , AGEC 350 , AGEC 408 , AGEC 413 , AGEC 415 , AGEC 416 , AGEC 420 , AGEC 425 , AGEC 432 , AGEC 434 , AGEC 447 , AGEC 448 , AGEC 451 , AGEC 452 , AGEC 453 , AGEC 484 , AGEC 491 , AGEC 495 .
[grid1 fn8] Any Texas A&M or transfer course (except ASCC 001-ASCC 003 and KINE 199 ) not used to meet other requirements.
